missingSafetyStop.evidence: Stop using the microwave now: switch it off at the socket and unplug it

inventedEvidence.evidence: 'From what you have checked' is vague, though the customer reported no checks, so it is minor

rationale: The reply gives an immediate, correct stop-use and unplug instruction and warns against opening the casing, so safety is handled well. It then escalates to an engineer straight away. It asks no question about metal or the waveguide cover on the right wall, even though the model is known and the likely cause (a burnt waveguide cover) is a cheap DIY fix. The 'from what you have checked' wording refers to checks the customer never reported, and the advice is slightly repetitive. It is safe but premature and not very useful diagnostically.
